decToBool : ∀ {ℓ} {A : Set ℓ} → Dec A → Bool
decToBool (yes _) = true
decToBool (no _) = false

infixl 6 _+ℚ_ _-ℚ_
infixl 7 _*ℚ_ _÷?_
infix  4 _≤?ℚ_ _<?ℚ_

_+ℚ_ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
_+ℚ_ = ℚ._+_

_-ℚ_ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ

_*ℚ_ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
_*ℚ_ = ℚ._*_

negℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
negℚ = ℚ.-_

0ℚ : ℚ.ℚ
0ℚ = ℚ.0ℚ

1ℚ : ℚ.ℚ
1ℚ = ℚ.1ℚ

halfℚ : ℚ.ℚ
halfℚ = ℚ.½

_÷?_ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
p ÷? q with q ℚP.≟ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no q≢0 = ℚ._÷_ p q {{ ℚ.≢-nonZero q≢0 }}

fromℕℚ : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
fromℕℚ n = ℚ._/_ (ℤ.+ n) 1

piℚ : ℚ.ℚ
piℚ = ℚ._/_ (ℤ.+ 314159) 100000

epsilonℚ : ℚ.ℚ
epsilonℚ = ℚ._/_ (ℤ.+ 1) 10000000

powℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
powℚ x zero = 1ℚ
powℚ x (suc n) = x *ℚ powℚ x n

factorial : ℕ → ℕ
factorial zero = suc zero
factorial (suc n) = suc n * factorial n

factorialℚ : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
factorialℚ n = fromℕℚ (factorial n)

_≤?ℚ_ : (p q : ℚ.ℚ) → Dec (p ℚ.≤ q)
p ≤?ℚ q with (ℚ.↥ p ℤ.* ℚ.↧ q) ℤ.≤? (ℚ.↥ q ℤ.* ℚ.↧ p)
... | yes pr = yes (ℚ.*≤* pr)
... | no npr = no (λ { (ℚ.*≤* pr) → npr pr })

_<?ℚ_ : (p q : ℚ.ℚ) → Dec (p ℚ.< q)
p <?ℚ q with (ℚ.↥ p ℤ.* ℚ.↧ q) ℤ.<? (ℚ.↥ q ℤ.* ℚ.↧ p)
... | yes pr = yes (ℚ.*<* pr)
... | no npr = no (λ { (ℚ.*<* pr) → npr pr })

absℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
absℚ x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = negℚ x
... | no _ = x

minℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
minℚ a b with a ≤?ℚ b
... | yes _ = a
... | no _ = b

maxℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
maxℚ a b with a ≤?ℚ b
... | yes _ = b
... | no _ = a

clipℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
clipℚ lo hi x = maxℚ lo (minℚ hi x)

NoZero : List ℕ → Set
NoZero [] = ⊤
NoZero (d ∷ ds) = (suc zero ≤ d) × NoZero ds

shape-size : List ℕ → ℕ
shape-size [] = suc zero
shape-size (d ∷ ds) = d * shape-size ds

shape-size-positive : ∀ (shape : List ℕ) → NoZero shape → suc zero ≤ shape-size shape
shape-size-positive [] tt = s≤s z≤n
shape-size-positive (d ∷ ds) (p , q) = ℕP.*-mono-≤ p (shape-size-positive ds q)

record Tensor (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  constructor mkTensor
  field
    data-vec : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size Shape)
    layout : Layout
    device : Device
    ownership : Ownership
    refcount : ℕ

open Tensor

shape-consistency : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → Vec.length (data-vec t) ≡ shape-size Shape
shape-consistency t = refl

shape-consistency-indexed : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) → toℕ i < Vec.length (data-vec t)
shape-consistency-indexed t i = subst (toℕ i <_) (sym (shape-consistency t)) (FinP.toℕ<n i)

layout-transform : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → Layout → Tensor Shape dtype
layout-transform t new-layout = record t { layout = new-layout }

tensor-map : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-map f t = record t { data-vec = Vec.map f (data-vec t) }

tensor-zipWith : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-zipWith f t1 t2 = record t1 { data-vec = Vec.zipWith f (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) }

tensor-foldr : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor Shape dtype → ℚ.ℚ
tensor-foldr f z t = Vec.foldr f z (data-vec t)

lookup-replicate : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : ℚ.ℚ) → Vec.lookup i (Vec.replicate x) ≡ x
lookup-replicate {zero} () x
lookup-replicate {suc n} Fin.zero x = refl
lookup-replicate {suc n} (Fin.suc i) x = lookup-replicate i x

zipWith-comm-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ x y → f x y ≡ f y x) → (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.zipWith f v1 v2 ≡ Vec.zipWith f v2 v1
zipWith-comm-vec {zero} f comm Vec.[] Vec.[] = refl
zipWith-comm-vec {suc n} f comm (Vec._∷_ x xs) (Vec._∷_ y ys) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ (comm x y) (zipWith-comm-vec f comm xs ys)

zipWith-assoc-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ a b c → f (f a b) c ≡ f a (f b c)) → (v1 v2 v3 : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.zipWith f (Vec.zipWith f v1 v2) v3 ≡ Vec.zipWith f v1 (Vec.zipWith f v2 v3)
zipWith-assoc-vec {zero} f assoc Vec.[] Vec.[] Vec.[] = refl
zipWith-assoc-vec {suc n} f assoc (Vec._∷_ x xs) (Vec._∷_ y ys) (Vec._∷_ z zs) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ (assoc x y z) (zipWith-assoc-vec f assoc xs ys zs)

map-id-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.map id v ≡ v
map-id-vec {zero} Vec.[] = refl
map-id-vec {suc n} (Vec._∷_ x xs) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ refl (map-id-vec xs)

map-compose-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f g : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.map (f ∘ g) v ≡ Vec.map f (Vec.map g v)
map-compose-vec {zero} f g Vec.[] = refl
map-compose-vec {suc n} f g (Vec._∷_ x xs) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ refl (map-compose-vec f g xs)

tensor-map-id : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → tensor-map id t ≡ t
tensor-map-id t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (map-id-vec (data-vec t))

tensor-map-compose : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (f g : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → tensor-map (f ∘ g) t ≡ tensor-map f (tensor-map g t)
tensor-map-compose f g t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (map-compose-vec f g (data-vec t))

tensor-replicate : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-replicate Shape dtype v = mkTensor (Vec.replicate v) ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)

tensor-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-zero Shape dtype = tensor-replicate Shape dtype 0ℚ

tensor-one : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-one Shape dtype = tensor-replicate Shape dtype 1ℚ

tensor-add : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-add = tensor-zipWith _+ℚ_

tensor-mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-mul = tensor-zipWith _*ℚ_

tensor-scalar-mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-scalar-mul s t = tensor-map (λ x → s *ℚ x) t

tensor-sum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → ℚ.ℚ
tensor-sum = tensor-foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ

foldr-replicate-leftId : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) (z x : ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ y → f x y ≡ y) → Vec.foldr f z (Vec.replicate {n = n} x) ≡ z
foldr-replicate-leftId {zero} f z x leftId = refl
foldr-replicate-leftId {suc n} f z x leftId = trans (cong (f x) (foldr-replicate-leftId {n = n} f z x leftId)) (leftId z)

theorem-tensor-sum-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → tensor-sum (tensor-zero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-sum-zero Shape dtype = foldr-replicate-leftId _+ℚ_ 0ℚ 0ℚ ℚP.+-identityˡ

data ActivationFunction : Set where
  ReLU : ActivationFunction
  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
  Tanh : ActivationFunction
  GELU : ActivationFunction
  Softmax : ActivationFunction
  LeakyReLU : ℚ.ℚ → ActivationFunction
  ELU : ℚ.ℚ → ActivationFunction
  Swish : ActivationFunction

exp-series-terms : ℕ
exp-series-terms = 24

rational-exp : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-exp x = go exp-series-terms 0ℚ 1ℚ 0
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k = acc +ℚ term
    go (suc n) acc term k =
      let acc' = acc +ℚ term
          k' = suc k
          denom = fromℕℚ k'
          term' = (term *ℚ x) ÷? denom
      in go n acc' term' k'

sin-series-terms : ℕ
sin-series-terms = 18

cos-series-terms : ℕ
cos-series-terms = 18

rational-sin : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-sin x = go sin-series-terms 0ℚ x 0
  where
    x2 : ℚ.ℚ
    x2 = x *ℚ x
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k = acc
    go (suc n) acc term k =
      let acc' = acc +ℚ term
          a = suc (k + k)
          b = suc a
          c = suc b
          denom = fromℕℚ (b * c)
          term' = negℚ ((term *ℚ x2) ÷? denom)
      in go n acc' term' (suc k)

rational-cos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-cos x = go cos-series-terms 0ℚ 1ℚ 0
  where
    x2 : ℚ.ℚ
    x2 = x *ℚ x
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k = acc
    go (suc n) acc term k =
      let acc' = acc +ℚ term
          a = suc (k + k)
          b = suc a
          denom = fromℕℚ (a * b)
          term' = negℚ ((term *ℚ x2) ÷? denom)
      in go n acc' term' (suc k)

rational-sqrt : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-sqrt x = go 12 1ℚ
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero guess = guess
    go (suc n) guess =
      let next = (guess +ℚ (x ÷? guess)) *ℚ halfℚ
      in go n next

log-series-terms : ℕ
log-series-terms = 24

rational-log : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-log x with x ≤?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ =
  let z = (x -ℚ 1ℚ) ÷? (x +ℚ 1ℚ)
      z2 = z *ℚ z
      s = go log-series-terms 0ℚ z 0 z2
  in (fromℕℚ 2) *ℚ s
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k z2 = acc
    go (suc n) acc term k z2 =
      let denomNat = suc (k + k)
          acc' = acc +ℚ (term ÷? fromℕℚ denomNat)
          term' = term *ℚ z2
      in go n acc' term' (suc k) z2

rational-acos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-acos x = go 12 0ℚ
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero θ = θ
    go (suc n) θ =
      let f = rational-cos θ -ℚ x
          fp = negℚ (rational-sin θ)
          step = f ÷? fp
          θ' = θ -ℚ step
      in go n θ'

apply-activation : ActivationFunction → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
apply-activation ReLU x = maxℚ 0ℚ x
apply-activation Sigmoid x =
  let denom = 1ℚ +ℚ rational-exp (negℚ x)
  in 1ℚ ÷? denom
apply-activation Tanh x =
  let ex = rational-exp x
      enx = rational-exp (negℚ x)
      num = ex -ℚ enx
      den = ex +ℚ enx
  in num ÷? den
apply-activation GELU x =
  let c = ℚ._/_ (ℤ.+ 1702) 1000
  in x *ℚ apply-activation Sigmoid (c *ℚ x)
apply-activation Softmax x = x
apply-activation (LeakyReLU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α *ℚ x
... | no _ = x
apply-activation (ELU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α *ℚ (rational-exp x -ℚ 1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
apply-activation Swish x = x *ℚ apply-activation Sigmoid x

tensor-softmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-softmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor-map rational-exp t
      s = tensor-sum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤?ℚ 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shape-size sh
    invN : ℚ.ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ ÷? fromℕℚ (suc k)
    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { data-vec = Vec.replicate {n = n} invN }
    normalize : ℚ.ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom t0 = tensor-map (λ e → e ÷? denom) t0

tensor-apply-activation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-apply-activation Softmax t = tensor-softmax t
tensor-apply-activation f t = tensor-map (apply-activation f) t

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ.ℚ → LossFunction

compute-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
compute-loss {sh} MSE pred target =
  let diff = Vec.zipWith _-ℚ_ (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      squared = Vec.map (λ x → x *ℚ x) diff
      sumsq = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ squared
  in sumsq ÷? fromℕℚ (shape-size sh)
compute-loss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target =
  let logp = Vec.map rational-log (data-vec pred)
      weighted = Vec.zipWith _*ℚ_ (data-vec target) logp
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ weighted
  in negℚ s
compute-loss {sh} MAE pred target =
  let diff = Vec.zipWith _-ℚ_ (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ absd
  in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shape-size sh)
compute-loss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target =
  let diff = Vec.zipWith _-ℚ_ (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
      term = Vec.map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤?ℚ δ) then halfℚ *ℚ a *ℚ a else δ *ℚ (a -ℚ (halfℚ *ℚ δ))) absd
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ term
  in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shape-size sh)

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  AdaGrad : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
    m1 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
    m2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
    t : ℕ

open OptimizerState

initial-optimizer-state : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initial-optimizer-state sh = mkOptimizerState (Vec.replicate 0ℚ) (Vec.replicate 0ℚ) (Vec.replicate 0ℚ) 0

apply-optimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → OptimizerType → OptimizerState sh → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh) → Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
apply-optimizer {sh} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let newv = Vec.zipWith (λ p g → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ g)) (data-vec params) grad
      newp = record params { data-vec = newv }
  in newp , state
apply-optimizer {sh} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = velocity state
      newV = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β *ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ β) *ℚ gᵢ)) v grad
      newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p vᵢ → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ vᵢ)) (data-vec params) newV
      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { velocity = newV }
  in params' , state'
apply-optimizer {sh} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = m1 state
      v = m2 state
      t0 = t state
      t1 = suc t0
      m' = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ gᵢ → β1 *ℚ mᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ β1) *ℚ gᵢ)) m grad
      v' = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β2 *ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ β2) *ℚ (gᵢ *ℚ gᵢ))) v grad
      denom1 = 1ℚ -ℚ powℚ β1 t1
      denom2 = 1ℚ -ℚ powℚ β2 t1
      mhat = Vec.map (λ mᵢ → mᵢ ÷? denom1) m'
      vhat = Vec.map (λ vᵢ → vᵢ ÷? denom2) v'
      step = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ vᵢ → mᵢ ÷? (rational-sqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) mhat vhat
      newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ s)) (data-vec params) step
      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { m1 = m' ; m2 = v' ; t = t1 }
  in params' , state'

  let v = m2 state
      v' = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → α *ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ α) *ℚ (gᵢ *ℚ gᵢ))) v grad

      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { m2 = v' }
  in params' , state'

  let v = m2 state
      v' = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → vᵢ +ℚ (gᵢ *ℚ gᵢ)) v grad

      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { m2 = v' }
  in params' , state'

  let n = shape-size sh
      fan = fromℕℚ n
      vec = Vec.map (λ i → (fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) *ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ)) (Vec.tabulate id)
  in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)

      vec = Vec.map (λ i → std *ℚ ((fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) *ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))) (Vec.tabulate id)

data RegularizationType : Set where

  L2 : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
  Dropout : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
  ElasticNet : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType

apply-regularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → RegularizationType → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
apply-regularization (L1 lam) params =
  Vec.map (λ w → lam *ℚ (if decToBool (w <?ℚ 0ℚ) then negℚ 1ℚ else 1ℚ)) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization (L2 lam) params =
  Vec.map (λ w → lam *ℚ w) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization (Dropout p) params =
  Vec.map (λ w → w *ℚ (1ℚ -ℚ p)) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization (ElasticNet lam1 lam2) params =
  Vec.zipWith _+ℚ_
    (Vec.map (λ w → lam1 *ℚ (if decToBool (w <?ℚ 0ℚ) then negℚ 1ℚ else 1ℚ)) (data-vec params))
    (Vec.map (λ w → lam2 *ℚ w) (data-vec params))

compute-regularization-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → RegularizationType → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
compute-regularization-loss (L1 lam) params = lam *ℚ Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ (Vec.map absℚ (data-vec params))
compute-regularization-loss (L2 lam) params = lam *ℚ Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ (Vec.map (λ w → w *ℚ w) (data-vec params))
compute-regularization-loss (Dropout p) params = p *ℚ Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ (Vec.map absℚ (data-vec params))
compute-regularization-loss (ElasticNet lam1 lam2) params =
  (lam1 *ℚ Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ (Vec.map absℚ (data-vec params))) +ℚ
  (lam2 *ℚ Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ (Vec.map (λ w → w *ℚ w) (data-vec params)))

record SchedulerType : Set where
  constructor mkScheduler
  field
    baseLR : ℚ.ℚ
    warmup : ℕ
    total : ℕ

open SchedulerType

apply-scheduler : SchedulerType → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
apply-scheduler sched epoch =
  let b = baseLR sched
      w = warmup sched
      t = total sched
  in if decToBool (ℕ._<?_ epoch w) then
       b *ℚ (fromℕℚ (suc epoch) ÷? fromℕℚ (suc w))
     else
       let e = suc epoch
           prog = fromℕℚ e ÷? fromℕℚ (suc t)
           c = rational-cos (prog *ℚ piℚ)
       in b *ℚ (halfℚ *ℚ (1ℚ +ℚ c))

clip-gradient-by-value : ∀ {n : ℕ} → ℚ.ℚ → Vec ℚ.ℚ n → Vec ℚ.ℚ n
clip-gradient-by-value clip v = Vec.map (λ g → clipℚ (negℚ clip) clip g) v

clip-gradient-by-norm : ∀ {n : ℕ} → ℚ.ℚ → Vec ℚ.ℚ n → Vec ℚ.ℚ n
clip-gradient-by-norm clip v =
  let sq = Vec.map (λ g → g *ℚ g) v
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ sq
      norm = rational-sqrt s
  in if decToBool (norm ≤?ℚ clip) then v else Vec.map (λ g → g *ℚ (clip ÷? norm)) v

lookup-replicate : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : ℚ.ℚ) → Vec.lookup i (Vec.replicate x) ≡ x
lookup-replicate {zero} () x
lookup-replicate {suc n} Fin.zero x = refl
lookup-replicate {suc n} (Fin.suc i) x = lookup-replicate i x

zipWith-comm-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ x y → f x y ≡ f y x) → (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.zipWith f v1 v2 ≡ Vec.zipWith f v2 v1
zipWith-comm-vec {zero} f comm Vec.[] Vec.[] = refl
zipWith-comm-vec {suc n} f comm (Vec._∷_ x xs) (Vec._∷_ y ys) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ (comm x y) (zipWith-comm-vec f comm xs ys)

zipWith-assoc-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ a b c → f (f a b) c ≡ f a (f b c)) → (v1 v2 v3 : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.zipWith f (Vec.zipWith f v1 v2) v3 ≡ Vec.zipWith f v1 (Vec.zipWith f v2 v3)
zipWith-assoc-vec {zero} f assoc Vec.[] Vec.[] Vec.[] = refl
zipWith-assoc-vec {suc n} f assoc (Vec._∷_ x xs) (Vec._∷_ y ys) (Vec._∷_ z zs) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ (assoc x y z) (zipWith-assoc-vec f assoc xs ys zs)

map-id-vec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.map id v ≡ v
map-id-vec {zero} Vec.[] = refl
map-id-vec {suc n} (Vec._∷_ x xs) = cong₂ Vec._∷_ refl (map-id-vec xs)

tensor-map-compose f g t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (map-compose-vec f g (data-vec t))

tensor-sum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → ℚ.ℚ

foldr-replicate-leftId : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) (z x : ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ y → f x y ≡ y) → Vec.foldr f z (Vec.replicate {n = n} x) ≡ z
foldr-replicate-leftId {zero} f z x leftId = refl
foldr-replicate-leftId {suc n} f z x leftId = trans (cong (f x) (foldr-replicate-leftId {n = n} f z x leftId)) (leftId z)

theorem-tensor-sum-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → tensor-sum (tensor-zero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-sum-zero Shape dtype = foldr-replicate-leftId _+ℚ_ 0ℚ 0ℚ ℚP.+-identityˡ

data ActivationFunction : Set where
  ReLU : ActivationFunction
  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
  Tanh : ActivationFunction
  GELU : ActivationFunction
  Softmax : ActivationFunction
  LeakyReLU : ℚ.ℚ → ActivationFunction
  ELU : ℚ.ℚ → ActivationFunction
  Swish : ActivationFunction

exp-series-terms : ℕ
exp-series-terms = 24

rational-exp : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-exp x = go exp-series-terms 0ℚ 1ℚ 0
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k = acc +ℚ term
    go (suc n) acc term k =
      let acc' = acc +ℚ term
          k' = suc k
          denom = fromℕℚ k'
          term' = (term *ℚ x) ÷? denom
      in go n acc' term' k'

sin-series-terms : ℕ
sin-series-terms = 18

cos-series-terms : ℕ
cos-series-terms = 18

rational-sin : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-sin x = go sin-series-terms 0ℚ x 0
  where
    x2 : ℚ.ℚ
    x2 = x *ℚ x
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k = acc
    go (suc n) acc term k =
      let acc' = acc +ℚ term
          a = suc (k + k)
          b = suc a
          c = suc b
          denom = fromℕℚ (b * c)
          term' = negℚ ((term *ℚ x2) ÷? denom)
      in go n acc' term' (suc k)

rational-cos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-cos x = go cos-series-terms 0ℚ 1ℚ 0
  where
    x2 : ℚ.ℚ
    x2 = x *ℚ x
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k = acc
    go (suc n) acc term k =
      let acc' = acc +ℚ term
          a = suc (k + k)
          b = suc a
          denom = fromℕℚ (a * b)
          term' = negℚ ((term *ℚ x2) ÷? denom)
      in go n acc' term' (suc k)

rational-sqrt : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-sqrt x = go 12 1ℚ
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero guess = guess
    go (suc n) guess =
      let next = (guess +ℚ (x ÷? guess)) *ℚ halfℚ
      in go n next

log-series-terms : ℕ
log-series-terms = 24

rational-log : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-log x with x ≤?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ =
  let z = (x -ℚ 1ℚ) ÷? (x +ℚ 1ℚ)
      z2 = z *ℚ z
      s = go log-series-terms 0ℚ z 0 z2
  in (fromℕℚ 2) *ℚ s
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero acc term k z2 = acc
    go (suc n) acc term k z2 =
      let denomNat = suc (k + k)
          acc' = acc +ℚ (term ÷? fromℕℚ denomNat)
          term' = term *ℚ z2
      in go n acc' term' (suc k) z2

rational-acos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rational-acos x = go 12 0ℚ
  where
    go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
    go zero θ = θ
    go (suc n) θ =
      let f = rational-cos θ -ℚ x
          fp = negℚ (rational-sin θ)
          step = f ÷? fp
          θ' = θ -ℚ step
      in go n θ'

apply-activation : ActivationFunction → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
apply-activation ReLU x = maxℚ 0ℚ x
apply-activation Sigmoid x =
  let denom = 1ℚ +ℚ rational-exp (negℚ x)
  in 1ℚ ÷? denom
apply-activation Tanh x =
  let ex = rational-exp x
      enx = rational-exp (negℚ x)
      num = ex -ℚ enx
      den = ex +ℚ enx
  in num ÷? den
apply-activation GELU x =
  let c = ℚ._/_ (ℤ.+ 1702) 1000
  in x *ℚ apply-activation Sigmoid (c *ℚ x)
apply-activation Softmax x = x
apply-activation (LeakyReLU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α *ℚ x
... | no _ = x
apply-activation (ELU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α *ℚ (rational-exp x -ℚ 1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
apply-activation Swish x = x *ℚ apply-activation Sigmoid x

tensor-softmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-softmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor-map rational-exp t
      s = tensor-sum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤?ℚ 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shape-size sh
    invN : ℚ.ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ ÷? fromℕℚ (suc k)
    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { data-vec = Vec.replicate {n = n} invN }
    normalize : ℚ.ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom t0 = tensor-map (λ e → e ÷? denom) t0

tensor-apply-activation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-apply-activation Softmax t = tensor-softmax t
tensor-apply-activation f t = tensor-map (apply-activation f) t

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ.ℚ → LossFunction

compute-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
compute-loss {sh} MSE pred target =
  let diff = Vec.zipWith _-ℚ_ (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      squared = Vec.map (λ x → x *ℚ x) diff
      sumsq = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ squared
  in sumsq ÷? fromℕℚ (shape-size sh)
compute-loss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target =
  let logp = Vec.map rational-log (data-vec pred)
      weighted = Vec.zipWith _*ℚ_ (data-vec target) logp
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ weighted
  in negℚ s
compute-loss {sh} MAE pred target =
  let diff = Vec.zipWith _-ℚ_ (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ absd
  in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shape-size sh)
compute-loss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target =
  let diff = Vec.zipWith _-ℚ_ (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
      term = Vec.map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤?ℚ δ) then halfℚ *ℚ a *ℚ a else δ *ℚ (a -ℚ (halfℚ *ℚ δ))) absd
      s = Vec.foldr _+ℚ_ 0ℚ term
  in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shape-size sh)

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
  AdaGrad : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
    m1 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
    m2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
    t : ℕ

open OptimizerState

initial-optimizer-state : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initial-optimizer-state sh = mkOptimizerState (Vec.replicate 0ℚ) (Vec.replicate 0ℚ) (Vec.replicate 0ℚ) 0

apply-optimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → OptimizerType → OptimizerState sh → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh) → Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
apply-optimizer {sh} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let newv = Vec.zipWith (λ p g → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ g)) (data-vec params) grad
      newp = record params { data-vec = newv }
  in newp , state
apply-optimizer {sh} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = velocity state
      newV = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β *ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ β) *ℚ gᵢ)) v grad
      newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p vᵢ → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ vᵢ)) (data-vec params) newV
      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { velocity = newV }
  in params' , state'
apply-optimizer {sh} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = m1 state
      v = m2 state
      t0 = t state
      t1 = suc t0
      m' = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ gᵢ → β1 *ℚ mᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ β1) *ℚ gᵢ)) m grad
      v' = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β2 *ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ β2) *ℚ (gᵢ *ℚ gᵢ))) v grad
      denom1 = 1ℚ -ℚ powℚ β1 t1
      denom2 = 1ℚ -ℚ powℚ β2 t1
      mhat = Vec.map (λ mᵢ → mᵢ ÷? denom1) m'
      vhat = Vec.map (λ vᵢ → vᵢ ÷? denom2) v'
      step = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ vᵢ → mᵢ ÷? (rational-sqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) mhat vhat
      newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ s)) (data-vec params) step
      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { m1 = m' ; m2 = v' ; t = t1 }
  in params' , state'
apply-optimizer {sh} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = m2 state
      v' = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → α *ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ -ℚ α) *ℚ (gᵢ *ℚ gᵢ))) v grad
      step = Vec.zipWith (λ gᵢ vᵢ → gᵢ ÷? (rational-sqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) grad v'
      newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ s)) (data-vec params) step
      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { m2 = v' }
  in params' , state'
apply-optimizer {sh} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =
  let v = m2 state
      v' = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → vᵢ +ℚ (gᵢ *ℚ gᵢ)) v grad
      step = Vec.zipWith (λ gᵢ vᵢ → gᵢ ÷? (rational-sqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) grad v'
      newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p -ℚ (lr *ℚ s)) (data-vec params) step
      params' = record params { data-vec = newP }
      state' = record state { m2 = v' }
  in params' , state'

data InitializationType : Set where
  Xavier : InitializationType
  He : InitializationType
  LeCun : InitializationType
  Orthogonal : InitializationType

scale-by-seed : ℚ.ℚ → Fin (shape-size (suc zero ∷ [])) → ℚ.ℚ
scale-by-seed seed i = seed

initialize-weights : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → InitializationType → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor sh dtype
initialize-weights sh dtype Xavier seed =
  let n = shape-size sh
      fan = fromℕℚ n
      vec = Vec.map (λ i → (fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) *ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ)) (Vec.tabulate id)
  in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)
initialize-weights sh dtype He seed =
  let n = shape-size sh
      fan = fromℕℚ n
      std = rational-sqrt ((fromℕℚ 2) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))
      vec = Vec.map (λ i → std *ℚ ((fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) *ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))) (Vec.tabulate id)
  in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)
initialize-weights sh dtype LeCun seed =
  let n = shape-size sh
      fan = fromℕℚ n
      std = rational-sqrt (1ℚ ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))
      vec = Vec.map (λ i → std *ℚ ((fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) *ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))) (Vec.tabulate id)
  in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)
initialize-weights sh dtype Orthogonal seed =
  tensor-replicate sh dtype seed

data RegularizationType : Set where
  L1 : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
  L2 : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
  Dropout : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
  ElasticNet : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType

apply-regularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → RegularizationType → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shape-size sh)
apply-regularization (L1 lam) params =
  Vec.map (λ w → lam *ℚ (if decToBool (w <?ℚ 0ℚ) then negℚ 1ℚ else 1ℚ)) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization (L2 lam) params =
  Vec.map (λ w → lam *ℚ w) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization (Dropout p) params =
  Vec.map (λ w → w *ℚ (1ℚ -ℚ p)) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization (ElasticNet lam1 lam2) params =
  Vec.zipWith _+ℚ_
    (Vec.map (λ w → lam1 *ℚ (if decToBool (w <?ℚ 0ℚ) then negℚ 1ℚ else 1ℚ)) (data-vec params))
    (Vec.map (λ w → lam2 *ℚ w) (data-vec params))

compute-regularization-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → RegularizationType → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
